name: Chief Shunsuke
source: Director Shunsuke is the Chief of TCIA as well as Minami Shunsuke's father. Rei will often say that he considers the Chief's family as his since they have a long history together. The Director is very wealthy and will do anything to protect his family and those he cares for. He likes to be carefree, but is serious when the time requires--or when he plays a prank.
